description: One line carrying two independent errands must become two items.
content: Call the vet and pick up feed at the co-op
notes: Two actions joined by 'and', both independently actionable, so line count and item count differ. Deliberately paired with 19's counterweight, segmentation-single-errand: one of these splits and the other must not, and no segmenter can pass both by preferring one behavior. Neither names a person, so both are cogs/daily only per the Tasks block. The vet is a role rather than a named person; if the model emits a contact for it that is a doctrine question, not a segmentation one, so it is not permitted here.
